common.perPageNote: The API returns 15 rows per page.
common.clientFilterNote: Filters apply to the loaded page only — the API has no server-side search yet.
common.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?

auth.loginSubtitle: Staff access to the hotel operations dashboard.
auth.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.inactive: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.
auth.guestBlocked: Guest accounts use the mobile app, not this dashboard.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.heroTitle: Everything your hotel needs, in one place.
auth.heroDescription: Manage hotels, rooms, reservations, services, and front-desk operations through one integrated, powerful platform.
auth.welcomeBackDescription: Sign in to access the hotel operations dashboard.

hotelSelector.label: Hotel context
hotelSelector.needHotelBody: This section works on one hotel at a time. Choose a hotel from the selector in the header.

overview.title: Overview
overview.kpiGapTitle: KPI metrics are not available yet
overview.kpiGapBody: The backend does not expose an overview / statistics endpoint (occupancy, revenue, ADR, RevPAR, arrivals, departures). This panel shows only real, backend-supported figures. No placeholder numbers are shown.
overview.noHotelForInventory: Select a single hotel to see its inventory snapshot.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.subtitle: Hotels you can access.
hotels.name: Name
hotels.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore. Used in URLs.
hotels.timezoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Africa/Cairo. Defaults to UTC.
hotels.newDesc: Create a hotel and assign it to a hotel group.
hotels.deleteReservationsHint: Hotels with reservations cannot be deleted to preserve booking and payment history. Deactivate the hotel instead.
hotels.activeHint: Inactive hotels stay in the system but are hidden from booking flows.
hotels.sectionBasicDesc: Identifies the hotel across the platform.
hotels.sectionLocationDesc: Where the property is and which timezone it operates in.
hotels.sectionBrandingDesc: Logo, cover image and photo gallery shown to guests.
hotels.sectionContentDesc: Tagline and description shown to guests in the app, per language.
hotels.sectionClassificationDesc: Star rating and the facilities shown on the hotel card.
hotels.depositPercentageHint: The deposit held from the guest’s card when they book, as a percentage of the stay price (1–100). Required.
hotels.depositPercentageRequired: Enter a deposit percentage from 1 to 100.
hotels.depositSectionDesc: Set the required percentage of the stay price to authorize as a deposit.
hotels.facilitiesHint: Selected from the facility catalog. Manage the catalog itself from Facilities.
hotels.facilitiesEmptyOptions: No active facilities in the catalog yet.

media.dropHint: Drag and drop, or click to browse.
media.dropHintGallery: Drag and drop images here, or click to add.
media.stagedHint: Pick a logo, cover and gallery photos now — they upload automatically once you save the hotel below.
media.invalidType: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
media.galleryFull: The gallery already has the maximum of {max} images.
media.someUploadsFailed: Hotel saved, but some images failed to upload. Add them again from Edit.

hotels.sectionSeoDesc: How this hotel appears in search results. Optional — falls back to the name and description above when left blank.
hotels.metaTitleHint: Shown as the search-result headline. Keep it under 60 characters.
hotels.metaDescriptionHint: Shown as the search-result snippet. Keep it under 160 characters.
hotels.indexableHint: Turn off to keep this hotel out of search engines — useful before launch.
hotels.ogImageNote: The social-share preview image reuses the cover image above. A dedicated share image can be added once a public website defines its own requirements.

guestDetail.mapHint: Click on the map or drag the marker to select the hotel location.
guestDetail.geolocationUnsupported: Geolocation is not supported by this browser.
guestDetail.geolocationFailed: Unable to get your current location.
guestDetail.sectionDesc: What guests see on the hotel page in the app. Leave anything blank to hide it.
guestDetail.receptionPhoneHint: Guests tap “Contact reception” in the app to call this number.
guestDetail.checkInModeHint: Who can check guests in. Payment only confirms a booking; the stay starts at check-in.
guestDetail.checkInModeBoth: Guest app self check-in and reception
guestDetail.highlightsHint: Feature cards shown in this order (up to 12).
guestDetail.unknownIcon: The guest app has no glyph for this key and will show a check mark. Pick an icon from the grid.
guestDetail.coordinatesHint: Both are required to show the map pin.
guestDetail.nearbyPlacesHint: Shown in the location section, in this order (up to 12).

hotels.pricesIncludeTaxes: Displayed prices include taxes and fees
hotels.pricesIncludeHint: Shown to guests on the room detail as “Included”. Leave off unless your rates really include them.

serviceFee.title: Service fee
serviceFee.hint: Added to every new booking as its own line (“Service fee”) and shown to guests before they book. Existing bookings keep the fee they were booked with.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.subtitle: The facility catalog hotels select from. Manage it centrally instead of typing the same facility into every hotel.
facilities.descriptionHint: Optional short line shown under the facility in the guest app.
facilities.keyHint: Stable machine identifier, e.g. free_wifi. Auto-generated from the English name when left blank.
facilities.iconHint: A Keenicons name, e.g. wifi. Optional — shown next to the facility where supported.
facilities.activeHint: Inactive facilities are hidden from the hotel picker but stay assigned to any hotel that already selected them.
facilities.newDesc: Create a facility hotels can select from.
facilities.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This is only possible when no hotel is still using it.

specs.customHint: Add any details guests should see, such as balcony, kitchenette, or smoking policy.

detail.tagHint: Optional label shown on the room detail, e.g. “Featured room”.
detail.inclusionsHint: Shown on the room detail under “The price includes”. Breakfast and free cancellation are added automatically from the options below.

rooms.title: Rooms & inventory
rooms.subtitle: Rooms for {hotel}.
rooms.statusMachineNote: The backend validates every status change against its room state machine. A booked room's status is managed by the reservation lifecycle.

media.dropHintGallery: Drag and drop images here, or click to add.
media.stagedHint: Pick gallery photos now — they upload automatically once you save below.
media.invalidType: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
media.galleryFull: The gallery already has the maximum of {max} images.
media.someUploadsFailed: Saved, but some images failed to upload. Add them again from Edit.

services.title: Stay services
services.subtitle: Service catalogue for {hotel}.
services.name: Name
services.manageNote: Reception can view the catalogue but not change pricing — the backend enforces this.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.subtitle: Reservations across the hotels you can access.
reservations.assignRoomNone: No free room of this type for these dates
reservations.assignRoomNote: Only rooms of the booked type that are free for the whole stay (and not under maintenance) are listed. The guest app shows the room number on the digital key.
reservations.noTransitions: No further transitions are available from this status.
reservations.manageNote: The backend re-validates every transition against the reservation state machine. Frontend only offers transitions valid from the current status.
reservations.newSubtitle: Search or register a guest, choose the stay, and create the reservation.
reservations.noRoomTypes: No active room types for this hotel.
reservations.estimatedPriceNote: Estimated {nights} night(s) at the room type's rate: {price}. The server computes and confirms the authoritative price when the reservation is created.
reservations.extendNote: Availability and the price are re-checked and calculated by the server from the room type's nightly rate. The amount is added to the folio and settled at checkout.
reservations.extendUnavailable: Extend stay is only available while the guest is checked in.

workspace.noPermission: You don't have permission for this panel.
workspace.holdAmountHint: Enter the deposit amount to authorise. The gateway remains the abstracted provider — no card data is collected here.
workspace.reviewOnlyPending: A decision can only be made while the session is pending manual review.
workspace.credentialNote: Shown only while the credential is active — this is the guest's app-delivered PIN.
workspace.checkoutBody: The backend computes the final settlement from the authoritative folio. This request is idempotent — a repeated call replays the completed result. You never enter an amount.
workspace.settlementPending: Settlement is still pending. Retry when the provider has responded.
workspace.settlementFailed: Settlement failed. You can safely retry.
workspace.noInvoiceYet: No invoice has been issued for this reservation yet.
workspace.loyaltyManageNote: Only staff with loyalty.manage may accrue or redeem. Redemption is only allowed against an eligible booking — the backend enforces both.
workspace.notificationsNote: This is the reservation's guest-facing notification feed, produced by the approved lifecycle. Notifications are never created from the dashboard.
workspace.documentAuthenticityNote: OCR reads the document; it does not prove the document is genuine or belongs to the guest. Check the original in person.

docReason.provider_not_configured: No OCR model is configured for this document type
docReason.manual_review_required_for_document_type: This document type always needs manual review
docReason.name_script_differs: Name entered in a different script (Arabic/Latin)
docReason.mrz_visual_conflict: MRZ disagrees with the printed page
docReason.birth_date_encoding_conflict: Birth date differs from the ID number
docReason.gender_encoding_conflict: Gender differs from the ID number
docReason.saudi_number_prefix_mismatch: ID number prefix doesn't fit the document

folio.authoritativeNote: The accommodation charge is the reservation's price snapshot and every total is computed by the backend. This view is read-only.

payment.abstractedNote: The payment gateway is an abstracted provider (no real third party, no card data). Only a deposit hold can be initiated here; capture and settlement run through the checkout workflow.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts.
users.name: Name
users.passwordEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
users.hotelsHint: Hotels this user may operate in. Ignored for a Group Owner (all hotels).
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? This is a hard delete and is audited.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Manage roles and see who can do what.
roles.matrixNote: Read-only overview — change a role's permissions from its Edit form.
roles.guestExplanation: Guest is a guest-facing identity used by the mobile app. It has no Dashboard staff capabilities.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

hotelGroup.title: Hotel group
hotelGroup.subtitle: Group profile and loyalty economics.
hotelGroup.name: Name
hotelGroup.ruleNote: The MVP ledger is immutable, has no expiry and no tiers. Rates are configured here, never defaulted — leaving a rate blank keeps loyalty unconfigured.
hotelGroup.ruleInactiveHint: The rule is created inactive on first read. Set the rates and activate it to start accruals.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile and dashboard preferences.
settings.name: Name
settings.profileReadOnly: Profile fields are managed by an administrator in the Users section.
settings.loyaltyLink: Configure loyalty economics in the Hotel group section.

gap.heading: Awaiting a backend endpoint
gap.noFake: No placeholder or fabricated data is shown. This module activates automatically once the endpoint ships.

guestsPage.subtitle: Every guest who has ever booked, across all hotels.
guestsPage.name: Guest
guestsPage.deletionRequestedBody: The guest asked in the app on {date} for their personal data to be deleted. Handle it under your data-protection process.
guestsPage.noReservations: This guest has no reservations within your hotel access.

digitalAccessPage.subtitle: Front desk — arrivals, departures and in-house guests.

folioPage.subtitle: Every reservation's charges, payments and outstanding balance.

checkoutPage.subtitle: Perform checkout and final settlement for a reservation.
checkoutPage.departuresHint: See who is checking out today, per hotel.
checkoutPage.settlementsHint: See every checkout's settlement status, per hotel.

settlementsPage.subtitle: Final settlements posted to the payment provider.

loyaltyPage.subtitle: Look up a guest's loyalty account and point ledger.
loyaltyPage.searchPrompt: Search for a guest to view their loyalty account.

reviewsPage.subtitle: Guest reviews and moderation.
reviewsPage.categoriesNote: The criteria guests rate this hotel on. They are shown to guests in this order; a deactivated category disappears from new reviews but past ratings are kept.
reviewsPage.deleteMessage: It will be removed permanently. This is only possible while no guest has rated it.
reviewsPage.deleteInUse: Guests have already rated this category, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead to keep past reviews intact.
reviewsPage.emptyCategories: No review categories yet. Add the criteria guests will rate this hotel on.
reviewsPage.analyticsEmpty: No reviews yet for this hotel.

serviceReviewsPage.subtitle: Guest reviews of individual hotel services, moderated separately from hotel reviews.

reportsPage.subtitle: Operational and financial reports.
reportsPage.exportHint: Export becomes available with the report endpoint.

auditPage.subtitle: A record of every sensitive action.

errors.genericBody: The request could not be completed.
errors.networkBody: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbiddenBody: You don't have permission to view this.
errors.notFoundBody: This record doesn't exist or is outside your access.
errors.rateLimitedBody: Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.serverBody: The server ran into a problem. Please try again shortly.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: There are no records to show.

countries.title: Countries
countries.subtitle: Global country reference data used across hotels, discovery and search.
countries.codeHint: Short unique code, e.g. EG. Stored upper-case.
countries.newDesc: Create a country. Cities are added from the Cities screen.
countries.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This is only possible when no city or hotel references it.

cities.title: Cities
cities.subtitle: Cities belong to a country and are referenced by hotels.
cities.newDesc: Create a city under a country.
cities.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This is only possible when no hotel references it.

guestApp.title: Guest app
guestApp.subtitle: Branding and first-run screens of the guest mobile app.
guestApp.logoHint: Splash screen and onboarding avatar. Square PNG with a transparent background works best.
guestApp.onboardingImageHint: Full-screen background on the welcome screen. Portrait, at least 1080×2340.
guestApp.defaultsNote: Every field is optional. A blank field keeps the text built into the app, so the app never shows an empty screen.
guestApp.faqNote: Shown in the guest app under Account → Help & support → FAQ, in this order. Entries need a question and an answer in at least one language.
guestApp.faqEmpty: No questions yet — the app tells guests there is no FAQ.
guestApp.removeConfirm: Remove this image? The app will fall back to its built-in artwork.
